note: 25lcp.com 301-> lacosta-properties-monaco.com (AWS WAF: HTTP 202 challenge to plain HTTP). Headless Chromium DOES pass the challenge (JS sets a token cookie and reloads, ~5-10 s; later pages in the same context get 200, the challenge reappears now and then), but scraper/browser.py BrowserFetcher fails it: it judges the INITIAL goto status (202) and opens a fresh context per URL, so no token is kept. To run on the server: BrowserFetcher should reuse one context and, on 202/awswaf, wait for the reload and re-read status/content.
